reason_for_new_version: V3 produced sixteen candidates, but separate-process replay rejected three printed separation enclosures (gamma .03125 theta numerator 3; gamma .5 numerator 5; gamma 1 numerator 7). V4 encodes conservative exact dyadic inequalities rather than requiring decimal round trips of nearly exact Arb enclosures to contain a recomputation. All v3 attempts and failures remain retained; no witness is refitted.
source_witnesses: Unchanged: four fixed seed-zero readouts at gamma 0.03125, 0.5, 1.0, 8.0, with their original checkpoints and hexadecimal coefficients. No refitting or training.
domains: Unchanged from v2: sixteen specified smooth nuisance circles at theta=2*pi*n/8, n in {1,3,5,7}, with every phi in the closed periodic interval [0,2*pi].
scope: Only the specified theta circle is certified. No universal-theta, full-torus, floating-point-machine injectivity, prediction or high-novelty claim follows.
arithmetic: python-flint 0.9.0 Arb balls, 128-bit midpoint precision; saved network/embedding/readout coefficients are exact dyadics in the real-valued network continuation.
new_bound: Unchanged v3 joint-mask activation bound and at most six uncertain masks. Only the global proof-bound encoding and comparison change.
criterion: Every leaf bounds the derivative residual below 2/pi - 4*2^-20. Round its global maximum strictly upwards to a multiple of 2^-20; require that exact epsilon < 2/pi. Round the positive resulting separation factor strictly downwards to a multiple of 2^-64. Replay every leaf <= the exact epsilon and verify the declared positive factor <= the recomputed rigorous factor. The stricter leaf buffer preserves the original separation criterion.
cover: Unchanged: complete prefix-free binary phi cover with exact Kraft sum one and standalone replay of every leaf.
failure_policy: Unresolved intervals, exhausted budget, rejected fixed witnesses, source mismatches and failed replays prevent certification. All sixteen outcomes are retained.
trust_boundary: Mathematical criterion, encoding/cover/enclosure implementation, Python and FLINT/Arb. Same-implementation standalone replay is not an independently implemented verifier or a Lean proof. Vertex branching and affine ReLU relaxation are established verification principles; their use alone is not claimed as new theory.

proof_bound_encoding.rounding: Integer mantissa/exponent of exact Arb endpoints; outward ceil/floor plus one additional dyadic unit. JSON integers stored as canonical decimal strings. Printed approximate balls play no role in proof checks.
